T: Three heroes. One very full kitchen.
D: Carol Danvers, Monica Rambeau and Kamala Khan keep swapping places every time they use their powers.
P: Serve the mains when Carol and Monica crash into the Khan family home in Jersey City.
S: Fried pastry triangles of spiced potato, peas and onion
Spiced potato, peas and onion folded into pastry triangles, fried at 180C until crisp, with a mint and coriander yoghurt.
Goose the flerken and her kittens

Cheddar cracker dough cut into fish shapes, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crunchy. Rub 100g cold diced butter into 150g plain flour with half a teaspoon salt and a pinch of paprika. Mix in 150g finely grated vintage cheddar and 2 tbsp cold water and press into a dough. Chill 20 minutes, roll out 3mm thick and cut with a small fish cutter. Mark a little eye with a skewer. Bake on lined trays at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crunchy. Cool and serve with a sweet chilli cream cheese dip.
Popcorn tossed in lime zest, chilli flakes and melted butter
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with butter and a little chilli and lime, served in silver bowls.
M: Yoghurt marinated chicken layered with basmati and crisp fried onions
Chicken thighs marinated in yoghurt and spices, layered with par-cooked basmati, fried onions and saffron milk, sealed and baked at 170C for 45 minutes.
Aladna lemon and oregano lamb skewers

Lamb skewers marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled and served with flatbread and herb salad. Cut 800g lamb leg into 3cm cubes and marinate 1 hour with the juice and zest of 1 lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt. Thread onto 8 skewers and grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred outside and pink inside. Warm 4 flatbreads. Toss parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and red onion with lemon and oil. Serve with the skewers and 200g tzatziki.
W: Vanilla cupcakes piped with red, blue and gold swirls
Vanilla cupcakes piped with red, blue and gold buttercream and a little star on top.
K: Mango blended with Greek yoghurt, milk and cardamom, over ice
Mango blended with yoghurt, milk, a little sugar and cardamom, poured over ice.

note.text: Captain Marvel, my mom made way too much food. There's always way too much food.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes, then crush them with the peas.
Fry the onion and garam masala and mix into the potato.
Cut the pastry into strips, fill and fold into triangles.
Fry at 180C in batches until crisp.
Blend the mint into the yoghurt for dipping.
Zest the limes and melt the butter with the zest and chilli.
Heat the oil in a large lidded pot and pop the corn, shaking now and then.
Toss the butter through, add a squeeze of lime juice and serve in silver bowls.
Marinate the chicken in the yoghurt and garam masala for 2 hours.
Rest the chicken in the fridge.
Slice the onions and fry until crisp, soak the saffron in warm milk.
Par-cook the rice in boiling water.
Layer chicken, rice and onions in an ovenproof pot, drizzle with saffron milk and seal tightly.
Bake at 170C.

ingredients.item: red, blue and gold food colouring

steps.text: Heat the oven to 175C and line a muffin tin.
Beat the butter and sugar, beat in the eggs, then fold in flour and milk.
Bake until golden.
Cool completely.
Beat the buttercream, split into three colours and pipe swirls on top with a little star on each.
Peel and slice the mangoes.
Blend with the yoghurt, milk, sugar and cardamom until smooth.
Pour over ice in tall glasses.

s.note: Fried pastry triangles of spiced potato, peas and onion
s.how: Boil and crush 600g potatoes with 150g peas, fried onion and a spoon of garam masala. Cut spring roll pastry into strips, fill and fold into triangles. Fry at 180C until crisp. Blend mint into Greek yoghurt for a cool dipping sauce.

s.note: Popcorn tossed in lime zest, chilli flakes and melted butter
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn. Melt 60g butter with lime zest and a pinch of chilli flakes and toss through. Squeeze over a little lime juice and serve in silver bowls like a snack on a space station.

m.note: Yoghurt marinated chicken layered with basmati and crisp fried onions
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in yoghurt and garam masala for 2 hours. Fry 2 sliced onions until crisp. Par-cook 400g basmati for 5 minutes. Layer chicken, rice and onions in a pot, drizzle with saffron soaked in milk, seal tightly and bake at 170C for 45 minutes.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes piped with red, blue and gold swirls
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Pipe swirls of red, blue and gold buttercream on top and finish each with a little star.

d.note: Mango blended with Greek yoghurt, milk and cardamom, over ice
d.how: Blend the flesh of 2 ripe mangoes with 300g Greek yoghurt, 250ml cold milk, a spoon of sugar and a pinch of ground cardamom until smooth. Pour over ice in tall glasses. Thick, cold and good for a family movie night.
